note: Créé via skill-creator (Task 14, correct-work PROJET — résorption des réserves héritées du dépôt 42c2a41) : skill-creator ne possédait AUCUN eval alors que verify-cross l'auditait (registre KB). 5 evals couvrant le cycle de création complet — draft, test prompts, évaluation qualitative/quantitative, itération, optimisation du déclenchement. Rédigé en anglais, langue du corps du SKILL.md.

evals.name: SC-create — Create a skill from scratch
evals.prompt: I want to build a new skill that generates release notes from git commits. Create it for me.
evals.expected_output: The skill-creation process is followed: decide purpose, draft the SKILL.md, propose test prompts before any benchmarking
expectations: The skill's purpose and rough behavior are stated before writing
A draft SKILL.md with frontmatter is produced
Test prompts are drafted before running evaluations

evals.name: SC-edit — Improve an existing skill
evals.prompt: Modify my existing skill to handle edge cases better and re-test it.
evals.expected_output: The existing skill is read, flaws identified, rewritten based on feedback, then re-tested
expectations: The current skill content is examined before editing
The rewrite is driven by evaluation feedback
The improved skill is re-tested with the same or expanded prompts

evals.name: SC-evals — Draft quantitative evals
evals.prompt: Run glm-with-access-to-the-skill on these test prompts and set up quantitative evals while the runs happen in the background.
evals.expected_output: Background runs are launched, quantitative evals are drafted in parallel, then results explained
expectations: The runs happen in the background while evals are drafted
Quantitative metrics accompany the qualitative review
The eval-viewer/generate_review.py script is proposed to display results

evals.name: SC-benchmark — Benchmark with variance analysis
evals.prompt: Benchmark this skill's performance and tell me if the changes I made actually improved it.
evals.expected_output: A benchmark with variance analysis compares runs and supports a keep/revert decision
expectations: Multiple runs are compared, not a single sample
Variance is accounted for in the verdict
A clear keep / iterate / revert recommendation is given

evals.name: SC-trigger — Optimize description for triggering
evals.prompt: My skill doesn't trigger when users ask about meal planning. Optimize its description.
evals.expected_output: The description is rewritten for better triggering accuracy, validated against trigger evals
expectations: The description is identified as the triggering surface
Trigger evals (should_trigger cases) are used to validate the rewrite
The optimized description is tested against positive and negative queries
